On 18 November, the EU-Mediterranean Peace and Security Forum brought together in Brussels, for the first time, representatives of the EU Member States, the ten Southern Neighbourhood partners, and leading think tanks. It provided a platform for dialogue and exchange on key security challenges and opportunities for cooperation.
